clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, the Encrypted Tablet sends novice troll rogues to Rwag. The rogue trainer inscribes its coded message and keeps his post inside the Den.

Novice troll rogues receive the Encrypted Tablet when they arrive in the Valley of Trials. Its ciphered words direct them to Rwag, an orc trainer who lives in the Den’s shaded caves. The slate keeps the local shadow operatives’ business discreet while testing whether new recruits can understand its message.

Deciphering the tablet brings recruits into contact with the Horde’s wider shadow network. When they report to Rwag, scouts learn that syndicates such as the Shattered Hand watch their progress. The syndicates rely on valley trainers to judge whether prospective cutpurses, spies, and assassins are sharp enough to serve the new nation.
